title: console: report tables group a select field by its raw value, so stages and statuses come out alphabetical instead of in the field's option order (objectui#12211 item 1)
body:
Filing gate ①: a reproduced product defect, split from list card objectstack-ai/objectui#12211 (item 1) as triage `6121957396` directs ("The dispatching seat splits it per item into sub-issues"). This card carries item 1 only. The parent keeps the items not yet split and closes when every item is split and closed.

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectui#12211. Domain and priority are inherited from the parent (`domain:ui`, `priority:p3`); `area:reports` per triage.
Reader: the `domain:ui` lane (either seat), from `pm:queue`.
Dedupe: the parent's table, item 1: `report group order alphabetical` (7 hits; nearest objectui#11809, closed, whose fix is in the pin but does not cover report tables) and `report table grouping option order` (62 hits, none on point).

## What happens (from the parent, item 1)

Source: the 2026-10-12 hosted-shape browser pass of HotCRM 4.0.1 on a cloud rig at production v1.36.0's pins (objectui `d758f2f20d`), zh-CN.

- **Reach:** the reports Opportunities by Stage, Opportunity Funnel by Owner → Stage, and Cases by Status and Priority.
- Rows read 成交, 需求分析, 谈判, 提案, 寻找客户, 资格审查. That is the alphabetical order of `closed_won, needs_analysis, negotiation, proposal, prospecting, qualification`.
- Cases read 已关闭, 已升级, 处理中, 新建, … (alphabetical by key).
- The bar chart in Opportunities by Stage follows the same order. The Funnel report's chart is ordered correctly; its table is not.
- objectui#11809's fix (PR objectui#11830, merged 2026-10-07) is in the pin, so this is a surface that fix did not cover.

## Acceptance

Report table rows (and their charts) follow the field's declared option order.
